title: Channel Synthesizer
text: Combine narrowband signals into multichannel signal, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for typecasting output; {Filter coefficients} sets the polyphase filter coefficients, {Filter structure} sets the hDL filter architecture Direct form, {Complex multiplication} sets the hDL implementation of complex multipliers Use 4 multipliers, {Divide butterfly outputs by two} sets the iFFT scaling, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling for typecasting output, {Coefficients} sets the data type of the coefficients, {Output} sets the data type of block output and {Enable reset input port} sets the option to enable reset input port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Input data real-valued row vector | complex-valued row vector

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Synthesized output data complex-valued column vector

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: HDL filter architecture Direct form transposed (default) | Direct form systolic

params.name: Complex multiplication
params.values: HDL implementation of complex multipliers Use 4 multipliers and 2 adders (default) | Use 3 multipliers and 5 adders

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for typecasting output Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow handling for typecasting output off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: Data type of the coefficients Inherit: Same word length as input (default) |

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of block output Inherit: via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input |

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to enable reset input port off (default) | on
